what: Earnings announcement dates and times from the free source (code/panels/download_earnings.py) checked against I/B/E/S Detail History Actuals (quarterly EPS, US file, announce date and time), 2016-01 to 2026-08. Aggregates only; the I/B/E/S records are licensed and are not stored here.
selection: 17 of the 201 us_largecap names: every fifth ticker in alphabetical order gave 41; these 17 were taken from that list before any comparison (the first five and twelve spread over the rest)

time_class.definition: before 09:30 Eastern = before the open; 16:00 or later = after the close; otherwise during hours

date_mismatches: AAL (4 days), ALL (1 day), ADM, AZO, NVDA (no I/B/E/S date within 5 days)

canonical_panel_check.what: The calendars used for the canonical CRSP panel in r71-r78 (free source, looked up under the ticker in crsp_panel_chars.csv) against the I/B/E/S record linked by CRSP header CUSIP and I/B/E/S ticker, 2014-2024. Aggregates only.
